many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def lines_of(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    L=[]
    for v in sorted(set(x for row in g for x in row)):
        cs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==v and v!=0]
        if cs:
            d=sum(1 for r,c in cs if c-r==cs[0][0]-cs[0][1])
            k=(cs[0][0]+cs[0][1]) if d else (cs[0][0]-cs[0][1])
            const=k; kind=('a' if d else 'd')
            L.append((v,kind,const,cs))
    return L

def fill(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    L=lines_of(g)
    res=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for v,kind,cs_ in [(l[0],l[1],l[2],l[3]) for l in L]:
        s=set(cs_)
        step=1 if kind=='d' else -1
        # extend along diagonal both ways until blocked
        while True:
            nr,nc=next(iter(s))
            nr2,nc2=(nr+step*2,nc+step*2) if False else None
        break
    # alternative: paint each diagonal line fully with its color? test both variants against demos
    return L

def rays(g,name):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    R=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if not v: continue
            # direction: nearest neighbor same color
            dirs=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
            d=None
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==v:
                    d=(dr,dc)

            if d is None: continue
            k = c-r if d==(1,1) else r+c if d==(-1,-1) else None
            R.append((d,k,v,r,c))
    return R

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def bands_of(g):
    h=len(g); seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if any(x for x in g[r]) and r not in seen:
            c=g[r][0]; rs=[r]
            for rr in range(r+1,h):
                if g[rr][0]==c: rs.append(rr)
                else: break
            seen|=set(rs); res.append((c,rs))
    return res

def solve(gi,go,dir=None):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])

                for i in range(H):

                    col=[go[i][j] for i in range(H)]

Like rays traveling down; when a ray hits a line of different color, it reflects? Classic ARC task! Demo4 matches the "light rays" puzzle: colored lines travel down (or diagonally); each line extends downwards until blocked by a line of its own color? Rows 2&3 have 3 and 9; row5 has 7; row7&8 have 3&9; etc. Output rows: 1@0,7@1,3@2,9@3,5@4,7@5,3@6,9@7,5@8,3@9,7@10,3@11,9@12,5@13,7@14,5@15,3@16,9@17,1@18,7@19. def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cells={ (i,j):gi[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]}
    dirs=[(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]
    best=None
    for dr,dc in dirs:
        used=set(); lines=[]
        for c in cells:
            if c in used: continue
            k=0; pos=[c]; cur=c
            while True:
                nxt=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                if nxt not in cells or cells[nxt]!=cells[cur]: break
                cur=nxt; k+=1
                pos.append(cur)
            for q in pos: used.add(q)
            # normalize: keep the run's canonical index relative to something? extend by 1 on both sides conceptually
            p=next(iter(pos))
            r=p[0]-p[1] if dc else p[1]  # family key guess; we'll compute later
            lines.append((dr,dc,k,p,r))
        cov=sum(l[2] for l in lines)
        if best is None or cov>best[0]: best=cov,lines
    n=len(best[1])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    tab={}   # residue -> color
    for dr,dc,k,p,fam in best[1]:
        d=fam       # for diag families fam=j-i (or i+j); for horiz use row index i
        kk=d%n
        existing=tab.get(kk,(None,None))
        # tie-break: larger line length wins
        if existing is None or k>=existing[1]:
            tab[kk]=(colors[p],k)
    return out

    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    kinds=['r','c','d','ad']
    info={}
    for kk in kinds:
        F=famlines(kk)

        lines=[]
        for k_,v in F.items():
            cnt=1
            while True:
                nxt=k_+ (1 if kk=='d' or kk=='ad' else 0)
                if nxt not in F and F.get(nxt)==v: break
                if F.get(nxt)==v: cnt+=1
                else: break
            lines.append((cnt,k_,v))
        if not lines: continue
        maxl=max(c for c,k,v in lines)
        cand=[(kk,k,v) for c,k,v in lines if c==maxl]
        info[kk]=(F,maxl,cand,lines)
    print('info',info)

def solve(g):
    Ls=[lines_of(g,kk) for kk in ['r','c','d','ad']]
    kind=['r','c','d','ad'][Ls.index(max(Ls,key=len))]
    seeds=sorted(lines_of(g,kind),key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0]))
    offs={o for _,o,_ in seeds}; cols={c for _,_,c in seeds}
    p=len(offs)
    idx={}
    for _,o,c in seeds:
        r=o%p
        d=min(offs,key=lambda o2:(abs((o2-r)%p)))
        if r not in idx or abs(d-r)%p < abs(idx[r]-r)%p:
            idx[r]=c
    grid=[[idx.get(o%len(g[0])),None,None] for k,o,c in seeds]
    return kind,idx,p

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
ti=G['Test input']
from collections import defaultdict
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    A=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: A[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    # order colors by their anti-diagonal sum
    orders=sorted(A.items(), key=lambda kv: min(p[0]+p[1] for p in kv[1]))
    sums=[]; cells_by_newsum=defaultdict(list)
    base=min(p[0]+p[1] for row in [g] for p in row if row[p][0]!=None and row[p][0]!=0 if False for p in row if row[p][0]!=0)
    sums=[min(r+c for r,c in pts) for color,pts in orders]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for idx,(color,pts) in enumerate(orders):
        new=sums[0]+idx
        for r in range(max(0,new-W+1), min(H,new+1)):
            c=new-r
            if 0<=c<W: out[r][c]=color
    return out
print('demo ok:', solve(G['Demo pair 8 input'])==G['Demo pair 8 output'])
res=solve(ti)
print(json.dumps(res))
